name: delta-down-points-to-value
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
LDL down 42 points to 118
note: In a change phrase the first number is the CHANGE and the second is the value. Returning 42 as an LDL would read as spectacular control.

name: delta-improved-by-to
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Total cholesterol improved by 30 to 198
note: The same shape written with 'improved by'.

name: hypothetical-if-were
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
If LDL were 70 the risk would fall below 5%.
LDL 118
note: A number inside a hypothetical never happened to this patient.

name: projected-value-on-therapy
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Projected LDL on statin ~80
note: A forecast is not a measurement.

name: hedged-possible-diabetes
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Problem List:
  Possible diabetes mellitus, to be confirmed
  Essential hypertension
note: A hedged diagnosis is neither a Yes nor a No. Diabetes changes both the risk estimate and the guideline pathway, so 'possible' must leave the field for the clinician rather than assert it.

name: hedged-suspect-diabetes
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Suspect diabetes; awaiting confirmatory A1c.
Problem List:
  Essential hypertension
note: 'Suspect ... awaiting confirmation' is explicitly unconfirmed.

name: hedged-cannot-exclude-diabetes
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Cannot exclude diabetes.
Problem List:
  Essential hypertension
note: 'Cannot exclude' is the opposite of a diagnosis, but it is not a clean No either.

name: confirmed-diabetes-still-yes
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Problem List:
  Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complication
note: An unhedged diagnosis is unaffected by the hedging guard.

name: statin-contraindicated
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Atorvastatin contraindicated (active hepatitis).
note: A contraindicated drug is not one the patient takes.

name: statin-not-indicated
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Statin not indicated at this time.
note: Nor is one that was never started.

name: double-negative-smoker
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
He is not a non-smoker.
note: A double negative inverts twice. Rather than guess which way the writer meant it, the field is left blank.

name: smokes-socially-is-current
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Social: smokes socially on weekends
note: Intermittent cigarette use is still current smoking for PREVENT.

name: occasional-smoker-is-current
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Social: occasional smoker
note: Same.

name: cigars-only-not-cigarette-smoking
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Denies cigarettes; smokes cigars occasionally.
note: The occasional-smoking phrasing must not override the cigar guard: PREVENT asks about cigarettes.

name: bp-both-arms-takes-higher
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BP right arm 152/90, left arm 138/84
note: When both arms are recorded the higher reading is the one used clinically.

name: orthostatics-take-resting
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BP supine 138/84, standing 118/72
note: The resting reading is the risk-model input, not the standing one.

name: map-and-pulse-pressure-ignored
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BP 138/84, PP 54, MAP 102
note: Derived pressures on the same line are not the systolic.
